prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Authentication Shift: Move the sign-in prompt to appear after pet selection and certificate creation rather than before friend selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Two Column Split Friend Picker Layout: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a split two-column layout with animated pet previews alongside choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select the pet personality that best fits your workflow and desktop environment."}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Pet Interaction Quick Start Tips Screen: Insert a dedicated quick tips screen right before the final home screen outlining key desktop controls and interaction hotkeys.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_commands", "home_intro"], "new_pet_commands": {"headline": "Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Quick tips to interact with your pet anytime during your work day.", "layout": "checklist"}}
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Visibility Status Check Flow: Introduce an active desktop overlay status verification and readiness notification flow during the waiting phase.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Companion", "body": "Verifying desktop overlay rendering permissions and activating companion graphics."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence and Multi-Pet Warning Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen clarifying how signing into an existing account recovers previously adopted pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your primary account email to automatically sync existing pets and save state across devices."}}
5: [adoption, incentive] Companion Welcome Gift Banner: Display a visual welcome badge on the adoption certificate screen offering bonus starter treats upon finishing naming.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Name Your Companion & Claim Welcome Kit", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Bonus 500 Starter Pet Treats Included", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Tip Carousel: Add an informative tip carousel component to the waiting screen to engage users while pet assets generate.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Double-click your pet on the desktop anytime to start a short break timer!", "style": "calm"}]}}
7: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Intro Journey Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen into a smooth story scroll layout introducing companion benefits before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Sanctuary", "body": "Discover how a desktop companion keeps you company and boosts productivity throughout your workday."}}
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Control Shortcut Toast Notification: Add a notification badge component on the home intro screen displaying hotkeys for summoning pet controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Shortcut: Press Alt+P (Option+P on macOS) anytime to open pet controls on desktop.", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [adoption, layout] Compact Pet Photo Upload Screen: Change the upload photo screen to a compact layout with clear formatting guidance for photo selection.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Upload Pet Photo Guidelines", "body": "For best results, upload a clear front-facing photo of your pet with good lighting and clear contrast.", "show_step_counter": true}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by rules 1 and 4.
Redesigning the pet selection screen layout while maintaining its core selection job is allowed under rule 2.
Inserting a new tips screen before the home intro is allowed under rule 4.
Adding overlay check and wait notifications to the waiting screen is permitted under rule 4.
Adding account recovery clarification hint to the sign-in screen is compliant with all rules.
Onboarding copy mentions bonus treats and a welcome kit, violating the prohibition on mentioning gifts, bonuses, or free extras in Rule 3.
Adding a tip carousel component to the waiting screen is allowed under rule 4.
Redesigning the story screen layout while still introducing the desktop companion is permitted under rule 2.
Adding a hotkey shortcut notification text component to home_intro is allowed under rule 4.
Redesigning the photo upload screen layout with updated guidelines maintains its core job and is allowed under rule 2.
